verdict.rationale: Docs position Weaviate as a RAG backend and provide official clients and an official MCP server for LLM/agent access. A community user confirms a LangChain retriever (WeaviateHybridSearchRetriever) exists but reports they could not get it to work asynchronously. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of LangChain/LlamaIndex or other framework integrations, evidence those integrations are maintained, LlamaIndex coverage, and a working async LangChain path.
